substitutions.reason: observed with VCS X-2025.06: the VIP coverage component fails at run time with Error-[FCIRS] Illegal value in enum bin range (bin range values outside the 4-bit ID enums), which cannot be suppressed
VCS X-2025.06 rejects the strong SVA operators (s_until_with, s_eventually, ...) in simulation: Error-[SVA-SONS] Strong operator not supported

observation.reason: the VIP monitor has a known defect (ACTIVE_NEEDS_COVERAGE, ZERO_BEAT_DROPPED): the checker observes the DUT pins with a testbench-owned, VIP-independent monitor and uses the VIP only to drive stimulus

findings.text: the VIP constant DATA_WIDTH is 512 in src/globals/axi4_globals_pkg.sv and the approved DUT configuration needs 32: a derived copy of that package with the new value is generated in the testbench tree; the VIP file is not edited (DUT-DV-020)
VIP inputs with no DUT port are tied to 0 in the bridge: buser, ruser

the bridge reads the VIP's VALID/READY outputs as 1 only when they are a defined 1 (X is seen as 0): awvalid, wvalid, bready, arvalid, rready. Observed with the VIP: it leaves these unknown until its first transfer, and an X on a handshake input corrupts the DUT state for the whole run.
VIP outputs with no DUT port are left unconnected (the DUT does not have them): awlock, awcache, awprot, awqos, awregion, awuser, wuser, arlock, arcache, arprot, arqos, arregion, aruser

VIP class axi4_master_coverage (src/hvl_top/master/axi4_master_coverage.sv) is replaced by a stand-in with the same name and the member the agent uses and no covergroup: observed with VCS X-2025.06: the VIP coverage component fails at run time with Error-[FCIRS] Illegal value in enum bin range (bin range values outside the 4-bit ID enums), which cannot be suppressed. The stand-in is found first through the include path; the VIP file is not edited. The VIP's coverage of its own stimulus is therefore NOT_RUN (DUT coverage is the testbench's own, spec-driven: DUT-DV-009).

VCS X-2025.06 reports Error-[ETMFCB] Enum type mismatch for the VIP's coverage bins (bin range 16 of the 4-bit ID enums in axi4_master_coverage.sv); the compile uses -suppress=ETMFCB (observed: without it the compile fails, with it it succeeds).

VIP unit master_assertions (src/hdl_top/master_assertions.sv) uses strong SVA operators: VCS X-2025.06 rejects the strong SVA operators (s_until_with, s_eventually, ...) in simulation: Error-[SVA-SONS] Strong operator not supported. A stand-in with the same ports and no properties is generated in the testbench tree instead of the VIP file; the VIP's own protocol assertions are therefore NOT_RUN. The DUT is checked by the scoreboard and by assertions derived from the specification (DUT-DV-020).
